description: Score the chemical severity of the three MEX-6 substitutions against the differences found in TZF pairs that bind the same element, and test the zif-1 3'UTR for the measured MEX-5 U-rich element
code:
# ============================================================================
# Iteration 3, final analysis.
# (A) The three MEX-6 differences all fall at positions that contact RNA in
#     20/20 models, so "peripheral" is not an available defence. Test instead
#     whether they are chemically milder than, or comparable to, the
#     differences found between TZF proteins that provably bind the same
#     element (BLOSUM62, weighted by base-contact frequency).
# (B) The one direct MEX-6 binding target is the zif-1 3'UTR (PMID 22265679).
#     Test whether it contains the measured MEX-5 minimal element (a tract of
#     6 or more uridines within a 9-13 nt window, PMID 17264081). Fetched from
#     WormBase ParaSite; if the resource is unreachable this is reported as
#     unavailable, not inferred.
# ============================================================================
import re, collections
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

B62_ORDER = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62_ROWS = """4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
B62 = {(B62_ORDER[i], B62_ORDER[j]): int(v)
       for i, row in enumerate(B62_ROWS.split("\n")) for j, v in enumerate(row.split())}

# ----------------------------------------- rebuild the contact table (self-contained)
RNA_BB = {"P","OP1","OP2","O5'","C5'","C4'","O4'","C3'","O3'","C2'","O2'","C1'"}
txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1RGO.pdb", timeout=120).text
models, cur = collections.defaultdict(list), None
for line in txt.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith("MODEL"): cur = int(line.split()[1])
    elif line.startswith("ENDMDL"): cur = None
    elif cur and line.startswith("ATOM"):
        if (line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]) == "H": continue
        models[cur].append((line[21], int(line[22:26]), line[17:20].strip(), line[12:16].strip(),
                            float(line[30:38]), float(line[38:46]), float(line[46:54])))
nm = len(models)
base_c = collections.Counter()
for atoms in models.values():
    prot = [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "A"]; rna = [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "D"]
    D = np.linalg.norm(np.array([a[4:7] for a in prot])[:,None] - np.array([a[4:7] for a in rna])[None], axis=2)
    s = set()
    for i, j in zip(*np.where(D < 4.0)):
        if rna[j][3] not in RNA_BB: s.add(prot[i][1])
    for r in s: base_c[r] += 1

OFFSETS = [("C1",-6),("C1",-4),("C1",-3),("C1",-2),("C1",-1),("C1",0),("C1",1),("C1",2),
           ("C2",0),("C2",1),("C2",2),("C3",-1),("C3",0),("C3",1),("C3",2)]
AI = {"C1":0,"C2":1,"C3":2,"H":3}
T_ZF1 = {("C1",-6):153,("C1",-4):155,("C1",-3):156,("C1",-2):157,("C1",-1):158,("C1",0):159,
         ("C1",1):160,("C1",2):161,("C2",0):168,("C2",1):169,("C2",2):170,("C3",-1):173,
         ("C3",0):174,("C3",1):175,("C3",2):176}
ZF_RE = re.compile(r"(?=(C.{7,12}C.{4,6}C.{2,4}H))")
def find_fingers(seq):
    out = {}
    for m in ZF_RE.finditer(seq):
        inner = re.match(r"C(.{7,12}?)C(.{4,6}?)C(.{2,4}?)H$", m.group(1))
        if not inner: continue
        s = m.start()+1; l1,l2,l3 = (len(g) for g in inner.groups())
        out.setdefault(s, (s, s+1+l1, s+2+l1+l2, s+3+l1+l2+l3))
    return sorted(out.values())
def fasta(a):
    return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta", timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])

ACC = {"TTP_Hs":"P26651","TIS11b_Hs":"Q07352","TIS11d_Hs":"P47974","TTP_Mm":"P22893",
       "MEX5_Ce":"Q9XUB2","MEX6_Ce":"Q09436","POS1_Ce":"G5EF15","MEX1_Ce":"Q7JM77"}
SEQ = {k: fasta(a) for k, a in ACC.items()}
ANCH = {k: find_fingers(s) for k, s in SEQ.items()}
pos_label, tisnum, cols = [], [], {k: [] for k in ACC}
for fi in (0, 1):
    for o in OFFSETS:
        pos_label.append(f"ZF{fi+1} {o[0]}{o[1]:+d}"); tisnum.append(T_ZF1[o] + 38*fi)
        for k in ACC: cols[k].append(SEQ[k][ANCH[k][fi][AI[o[0]]] + o[1] - 1])

# ------------------------------------------------- (A) severity of differences
PAIRS = [("TIS11b_Hs","TIS11d_Hs","same element"), ("TTP_Hs","TTP_Mm","same element"),
         ("TTP_Hs","TIS11d_Hs","same element"), ("TTP_Hs","TIS11b_Hs","same element"),
         ("MEX5_Ce","MEX6_Ce","UNDER TEST"),
         ("MEX5_Ce","TTP_Hs","different element"), ("MEX5_Ce","POS1_Ce","different element")]
rows, detail = [], []
for a, b, cls in PAIRS:
    diffs = [(pos_label[i], tisnum[i], cols[a][i], cols[b][i], B62[(cols[a][i], cols[b][i])],
              base_c[tisnum[i]]/nm) for i in range(30) if cols[a][i] != cols[b][i]]
    for d in diffs: detail.append({"pair": f"{a} vs {b}", "class": cls, "position": d[0],
                                   "TIS11d_num": d[1], "aa_1": d[2], "aa_2": d[3],
                                   "blosum62": d[4], "base_contact_freq": d[5]})
    sc = [d[4] for d in diffs]; w = [d[5] for d in diffs]
    rows.append({"pair": f"{a} vs {b}", "class": cls, "n_diff": len(diffs),
                 "mean_blosum62": float(np.mean(sc)) if sc else np.nan,
                 "min_blosum62": min(sc) if sc else np.nan,
                 "n_diff_at_base_contacting": int(sum(x > 0.5 for x in w)),
                 "discriminator_differs": any(d[0].endswith("C1-2") for d in diffs)})
sev = pd.DataFrame(rows); det = pd.DataFrame(detail)
sev.to_csv("substitution_severity_by_pair.csv", index=False)
det.to_csv("substitution_severity_detail.csv", index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
print(sev.to_string(index=False))
print("\nthe differences, position by position")
print(det.to_string(index=False))

# -------------------------------------------------- (B) zif-1 3'UTR U-richness
utr, source = None, None
try:
    g = requests.get("https://parasite.wormbase.org/rest-18/lookup/symbol/caenorhabditis_elegans_prjna13758/zif-1",
                     params={"expand": "1", "content-type": "application/json"}, timeout=90)
    g.raise_for_status(); info = g.json()
    tids = [t["id"] for t in info.get("Transcript", [])]
    print(f"\nzif-1 gene {info.get('id')} transcripts {tids}")
    for tid in tids:
        s = requests.get(f"https://parasite.wormbase.org/rest-18/sequence/id/{tid}",
                         params={"type": "utr3", "content-type": "application/json"}, timeout=90)
        if s.ok and "seq" in s.json():
            utr = s.json()["seq"].upper().replace("T", "U"); source = tid; break
except Exception as e:
    print(f"\nWormBase ParaSite request failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")

if utr:
    print(f"zif-1 3'UTR from {source}: {len(utr)} nt, U content {100*utr.count('U')/len(utr):.1f}%")
    hits = []
    for w in range(9, 14):
        for i in range(len(utr) - w + 1):
            if utr[i:i+w].count("U") >= 6: hits.append((i+1, w, utr[i:i+w]))
    starts = sorted({h[0] for h in hits})
    print(f"windows of 9-13 nt containing >=6 U: {len(hits)} (at {len(starts)} distinct start positions)")
    print("first 10 distinct matches:", [(h[0], h[2]) for h in hits[:10]])
    # shuffled control, same base composition
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0); arr = np.array(list(utr)); ctrl = []
    for _ in range(1000):
        rng.shuffle(arr); s2 = "".join(arr)
        ctrl.append(len({i+1 for w in range(9, 14) for i in range(len(s2)-w+1) if s2[i:i+w].count("U") >= 6}))
    ctrl = np.array(ctrl)
    print(f"shuffled control (1000x, same composition): mean {ctrl.mean():.1f} start positions, "
          f"observed {len(starts)}, empirical p = {(ctrl >= len(starts)).mean():.3f}")
else:
    print("\nzif-1 3'UTR sequence could not be retrieved programmatically; no U-richness result is reported.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5))
colmap = {"same element": "#2b5d8c", "UNDER TEST": "#b03030", "different element": "#9a9a9a"}
for cls in ["same element", "UNDER TEST", "different element"]:
    d = det[det["class"] == cls]
    ax[0].scatter(d["blosum62"] + np.random.default_rng(1).normal(0, 0.06, len(d)),
                  d["base_contact_freq"] + np.random.default_rng(2).normal(0, 0.012, len(d)),
                  s=70, c=colmap[cls], label=cls, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.85)
for _, d in det[det["class"] == "UNDER TEST"].iterrows():
    ax[0].annotate(f"{d['position']} {d['aa_1']}/{d['aa_2']}", (d["blosum62"], d["base_contact_freq"]),
                   fontsize=8, xytext=(5, -10), textcoords="offset points", color="#b03030")
ax[0].axvline(0, ls=":", c="k", lw=0.8)
ax[0].set_xlabel("BLOSUM62 score of the substitution (higher is more conservative)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction of models where the TIS11d residue contacts an RNA base")
ax[0].set_title("Every difference at the 30 contacting positions,\nby chemical severity and by how directly the position reads RNA")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower left")

y = np.arange(len(sev))
ax[1].barh(y, sev["mean_blosum62"], color=[colmap[c] for c in sev["class"]])
ax[1].set_yticks(y); ax[1].set_yticklabels([f"{r.pair}  (n={r.n_diff})" for r in sev.itertuples()], fontsize=8)
ax[1].invert_yaxis(); ax[1].axvline(0, c="k", lw=0.8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("mean BLOSUM62 score across the differing positions")
ax[1].set_title("Mean severity of the differences per pair\n(pairs with no difference are omitted from the mean)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
